image_transform: Whole views; aspect-preserving fit into common tiles, padding and identical labels. No flip or content crop.
cadence: All recorded frames retained; 10 control frames per playback second; display only.

notes.text: Open and align above the nearer orange can for a gentle touch/lift test; identity of the empty can remains unknown.
Descend with open fingers around the orange can to contact height; keep the hand vertical.
Gently close around the orange can for the first touch test, without translating the hand.
Lift the orange can slightly with a gentle opening target, observing whether it follows or slips before selecting it.
Probe retention at a slightly wider finger target while just above the table; observe slip rather than treating commanded aperture as a weight measurement.
The orange can slipped at the wider setting. Reapproach on the table for a narrower, repeatable comparison grip.
Establish a gentle 0.75 opening contact on the orange can before comparing its response to the blue can.
Raise the orange can 6 cm at the comparison opening and inspect whether it follows or slips.
Orange is visibly retained at 0.75. Slightly widen to 0.77 while holding low, to obtain a repeatable contact/slip comparison.
Check whether the orange can remains at the same relative finger height during a further small lift with the light comparison grip.
Return orange close to its original table position, then compare the blue can using the same gentle contact setting.
Release orange on the table and withdraw vertically with open fingers before moving to blue.
Move above the blue can with open fingers, clear of both cans, for the comparison touch test.
Descend vertically around the blue can with open fingers to the same comparison grasp height.
Make gentle finger contact with the blue can at the same 0.75 comparison opening used on orange.
Repeat the same low lift with blue and observe its retention under gentle contact.
Widen blue's contact to the same light 0.77 setting used for orange and inspect slip before choosing.
Blue visibly slipped at 0.77. Clear it and return to orange to verify retention at the same light contact setting.
Align over orange with open fingers, staying above the can rim until centered.
Lower around orange to the repeatable contact height for verification.
Reestablish gentle contact on orange before repeating the light-grip lift comparison.
Lift orange slightly again, then compare stability at the same opening where blue slipped.
Verify orange's retention at the light comparison setting where blue slipped, keeping the can only slightly above the table.
Orange also slipped at 0.77, so that test is inconclusive. Reapproach for a finer 0.76 contact comparison.
Test orange with the intermediate contact opening, lifting only four centimeters to observe slip safely.
Check sustained orange retention at 0.76 before repeating this finer contact test on blue.
Orange remains visibly retained at 0.76. Set it back on the table to test blue at the same opening.
Release orange upright and withdraw with open fingers, then begin moving toward blue at safe clearance.
Align above blue for the matched 0.76 opening test; keep fingers open while traversing.
Descend around the blue can to the matched touch height without closing yet.
Apply the same intermediate 0.76 contact opening to blue, then lift four centimeters for a matched retention comparison.
Blue also lifts at 0.76. Check a slightly lighter contact while hovering low to distinguish sustained support from slip.
Blue remains suspended at 0.764. Test 0.766 at the same low height to locate the gentle-contact retention boundary.
Blue appears to be slipping at 0.766. Hold steady briefly to distinguish gradual slip from a stable grasp.
Blue is visibly sliding through the fingers at 0.766. Release it low and return to orange for the same sustained-contact test.
Center over orange and descend open to the same grasp height for the final fine-contact comparison.
Lift orange four centimeters at 0.76 before testing the same marginal opening where blue gradually slipped.
Hold orange at the marginal 0.766 opening and observe whether it slips like blue.
Orange dropped rapidly at the marginal contact setting, unlike blue's slower slip; blue is the lighter candidate. Move above blue to retrieve it securely.
Descend open around the blue can to the verified grasp height for secure pickup.
